notes.title: Build 1599 Patch notes
notes.content:
Patch notes build 1599 (437766-438012)
Changes too numerous to mention – here are the highlights
•	Fixed a bug that prevented late game mechs from being added to the market
•	Kerensky and merit earnings now change based on difficulty
•	Fixed issues with elementals getting stuck everywhere
•	Tuned elemental attacking for both enemy and allied (they should be visibly more prevalent and not swarm so close to target so you can get hits in as well)
•	Watercooling bonus reduced
•	Filter for mech list in mechlab (yes finally!)
•	Elementals have new SFX
•	Tuned Iron talon battle
•	New Kodiak load screen
•	Artist Level cleanups including some floating (but not all just yet), and collision issues
•	Tractor destruction VFX
•	Fix bug where mines weren’t scannable if you were a client
•	Mech animation and cockpit animation bug fixes
•	Salvage screen now shows additional salvage from crates
•	New soundtracks in digital extras
•	Missing destructible SFX
•	Audio Mix tweaked
•	Certain PIPs updated to be consistent with story events
•	Small localization fixes
•	Fix for elementals flying too high
•	Cleaned up eyes direction on some characters
•	Bodies in cinematic no longer “pre burning”
•	Fixed issues with character placements in briefings
•	Fixed issue with riflemen IIC where it fired with an offset to the reticule
•	NIS VFX improvements
•	New paperdolls for Caspian, Kirhiz, Tigress
•	HUN05 and ALS02 fix to optional objectives so they trigger properly
•	Cinematics updated
•	ALS03B, HUN04, ALS06, Als07 music added
•	Rook and Zarna have better PIPS
•	Research auto completes after campaign is finished.
•	Fix for paperdolls not showing sometimes
•	More fixes for A Grizzly trial to make traversal smoother
•	Caspian battle tuning
•	Fix to holotable assets in mission briefings
•	Remove headless BG characters
•	Subtitle fixes
•	Fix to Mirror paperdoll option not working until mission restarted
•	Rook given better shadow in mission central
•	Better ending cinematic
•	Iron talon NIS audio
•	Small UI bug fixes

notes.title: Patch Notes Build 1573
notes.content:
Path Notes Build 1573 (437187-437454)
Highlights (too many items to list so highlights only)
•	Coop login fixed
•	Horde mode bug fixes
•	Fix popping in NIS
•	Caspian balance pass in ALS07
•	Fix hang on abort mission
•	Art cleanup in all levels
•	Grizzly Trial – frustrations noted. Removed or changed collision on some greebles and changed JJ nodes to help Ai in Grizzly Trial
•	Localization update
•	Hun03 difficulty reduced
•	Hun04 balance tweaks (made easier as well)
•	Hun 05 aerospace pilots skill reduced, and level made easier
•	ALS01 3rd repair bay added
•	ALS02 very slight difficulty reduction
•	Story mode made easier
•	Subtitles timing fixed
•	Optimizing elementals
•	Spelling error fixes
•	Notifications for research
•	Fix for rain in coop
•	Improved ghosting effect with FSR
•	Helmets in PIPS
•	Fixes to mech walk and run anims, cockpit bob
•	Fix tutorial bugs with custom controls
•	Fix some achievement bugs
•	Cinematic updates
